_comment: Bild-Bibliothek-Config für scripts/build-image-library.mjs (Umsetzungs-Brief §5). Datengetrieben: Marke editiert Looks/Prompts/Kombinationen ohne Code. Globale Bild-DNA (`style`) liegt über ALLEN Bildern, damit die Bibliothek aus einem Guss wirkt. Dateinamen exakt nach §3.1/§3.2, damit render-preview.js + die Auswahl-Nodes sie finden.
style: a real photograph with genuine depth, texture and detail — never a flat colour block or solid colour field, soft natural daylight with gentle shadows, cohesive cool ocean-toned palette (deep navy, teal, seafoam, pale sand and off-white), airy and calm with a refined editorial mood, fine film grain, vertical 4:5, no logo, no text, never harsh black, never neon
hero_template: Editorial fashion photograph of a {category}, {look}, single-garment focus on a ghost / invisible mannequin against a near-black seamless studio backdrop, no logo, no text, photorealistic, ultra-detailed fabric, cohesive cool color grade with fine film grain, vertical 4:5.

looks.quietMinimal: soft diffuse daylight, muted stone / off-white / grey palette, matte natural wool & cotton, calm and reduced with generous negative space
looks.techAvant: cool directional studio light with hard shadows, charcoal / black / steel with a cyan edge, matte technical recycled nylon, sharp and architectural, future-leaning
looks.y2kStreet: high-contrast flash with glossy highlights, saturated magenta / cyan on black plus washed denim blue, glossy nylon & denim, bold, urban, playful
looks.softCouture: warm soft golden light, blush / cream / champagne palette, fluid draping silk & fine wool, elegant, tactile, editorial
looks.utility: flat overcast light, olive / khaki / sand / rust palette, rugged canvas & raw denim, functional, grounded, weathered
looks.sport: bright clean even light, restrained palette with one energetic accent, matte performance fabric, fresh, dynamic, precise

material_template: Macro close-up of {material} fabric, raking side light revealing weave and sheen, filling the frame, photorealistic, same cool grade and fine grain.

mood.calm-mono: calm pale seafoam and soft grey daylight over still water, serene, vast airy negative space
mood.bold-neon: bold deep-teal and aqua tones in bright directional daylight, confident and dynamic, glossy water reflections
mood.soft-drape: extreme close-up of fluid fabric folds in soft natural daylight, pale sand and seafoam tones
mood.sharp-structure: architectural concrete edges and structured pleats in cool daylight, teal and slate
mood.clean: near-empty off-white studio in soft daylight, one clean material edge, immense negative space
mood.expressive: layered ocean-toned colour-blocked textures (teal, navy, seafoam, sand) in bright light, graphic and dynamic
mood.vintage: soft faded film look in cool muted ocean tones, weathered linen surface, gentle grain
mood.future: sleek cool ocean-metallic technical surface in soft blue daylight, refined and forward-looking
mood.concrete: raw poured concrete texture in cool daylight, soft teal-grey, calm
mood.nature: soft organic foliage and natural linen in bright diffuse daylight, earthy seafoam and sand, tactile
mood.neon: glossy aqua and teal reflections on a wet surface at blue hour, calm cool energy
mood.atelier: a tailor's atelier worktable with shears, chalk and fabric bolts in soft natural window light, airy and warm-cool balanced
mood.sportcore: sunlit running track with painted lane lines and woven performance-fabric texture caught mid-motion, fresh and precise, cool daylight

_context_note: Kontext-Kacheln sind GARMENT-FREI (Szenen/Texturen, keine Kleidungsstücke) — sie erscheinen in jeder Kategorie-Reise; ein fremdes Kleidungsstück (z. B. eine Jacke in der Hosen-Reise) würde als Auswahl missverstanden.

context.occasion-everyday: editorial photograph of a quiet morning city street with long soft shadows and a bicycle leaning against a pale wall, soft daylight, candid calm, cool ocean-toned grade, shallow depth of field, no people, no clothing
context.occasion-work: editorial photograph of a calm light-filled minimal workspace, wooden desk with a closed notebook and a ceramic cup, soft daylight, refined and quiet, cool neutral tones, no people, no clothing
context.occasion-event: editorial photograph of a refined interior at dusk, soft warm-cool light, glasses and gentle glossy reflections, airy bokeh, elegant and celebratory, no people, no clothing
context.occasion-active: editorial photograph of a sunlit urban running track with painted lane markings and subtle motion-blurred light, dynamic and fresh, soft early daylight, cool ocean grade, fine grain, no people, no clothing
context.season-all: editorial still life of four folded fabric textures side by side — linen, cotton, wool and a technical weave — on a light table in soft even daylight, cool neutral palette, no garments
context.season-warm: editorial photograph of light linen fabric drifting in a warm breeze in bright soft daylight, airy folds, pale sand and seafoam tones, shallow depth of field
context.season-cold: editorial photograph of a frost-laced window pane and soft mist over calm water in cool blue daylight, muted ocean-blue tones, gentle grain, no people, no clothing
